title: CurseSMP
description: A server with the Lifesteal plugin installed
body:
**CurseSMP** is a competitive Minecraft Lifesteal server where every fight matters. Defeat other players to steal their hearts, grow stronger, and dominate the server. Whether you enjoy PvP, grinding loot, or building powerful alliances, CurseSMP offers a balanced and intense survival experience.

The server is optimized for smooth gameplay with active updates, fair mechanics, and a growing community. Team up with friends or go solo—your strategy decides your fate.

Join now and start your journey to become the most powerful player on **CurseSMP**.

**IP:** CurseSMP.fun  
**PORT:** 40237
**Version:** 1.21+ (Java & Bedrock Supported)
